summary: Designs and freezes the governed development workflow PCAE follows in a branch-protected repository, before any execution capability is implemented. Freezes seven repository roles (Repository Owner, Maintainer, Contributor, Human Reviewer, PCAE, AI Coding Agent, Permission Broker (future)) with responsibilities/authority/limitations; the canonical Task -> Feature Branch -> Implementation -> Validation -> Review -> Approval -> Merge -> Main development flow; branch policy (protected main, feature branches, a design-only release-branch placeholder, and the documented current transitional posture -- admin enforcement off, 1 required review, conversation resolution required, force-push/deletion blocked); the AI Participation Model (frozen may/may-not lists, current status not implemented beyond assistive preparation); an explicit Git-Approval-vs-Execution-Approval distinction extending INV-008; PR requirements; a governance-command mapping table; and a future-integration design (Permission Broker, Human Approval Gate, Execution Boundary, Audit Boundary, Rollback Readiness Boundary) marking every future capability Not implemented. Design/freeze only -- no runtime enforcement, execution capability, permission broker enforcement, shell mediation, backend invocation, adapter execution, Telegram inbound, audit storage, rollback execution, emergency stop implementation, execution enablement, PR automation, GitHub Actions changes, GitHub API integration, automatic PR creation, automatic merge, automatic approval, merge queues, or branch creation automation implemented. Added docs/V0_2_PR_COMPATIBLE_GOVERNED_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md and docs/PHASE_107_PR_COMPATIBLE_GOVERNED_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md. 120 new tests. Focused group (441), documentation/release group (246), and release/lifecycle regression group (1458) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline). No group required a sequential fallback -- Phase 107D's parallel-validation hardening held with no new xdist collision observed.
